verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an API-first product with an extensively documented public API: an API reference with open-source SDKs, REST endpoints such as POST /v0/agent/human, and a probe-verified openapi.json and llms.txt. Inboxes, messages, threads, webhooks and permissions are all operable via API. Community comments describe it as 'SES + api access' and praise the SDK examples in the dashboard, which corroborates that the API exists, but no one reports hands-on use of it. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of API reliability and depth in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
